decisions.reason: The required complete drawing set remains unchanged; the source only specifies its delivery formats and format-export sequence.
The requirement to deliver a 3D shaft assembly model remains valid unchanged; the source modifies only the model file formats.
The file-format decision does not alter the established color treatment for drawing views.
Message 83 independently modifies drawing dimensions, and that same-message annotation Event already exists; the source file-format decision does not change those annotation requirements.
Requiring editable SolidWorks deliverables does not change ČSN/EN compliance, mandate a drawing template, or negate the historical availability of an Inventor template.
The specified output formats do not alter the assembly-based drawing-numbering rule.
The delivery-format change does not modify any part material or the requirement to show materials on drawings.
The source decision concerns deliverable formats and does not alter the bushing's guidance, fit, retention, or hole configuration.
The deliverable-format decision does not change any main-shaft geometry or machining dimension.
The source does not alter the sliding mandrel's arrangement, motion path, holes, or required keyway groove.
The selected CAD and drawing formats do not change the required premachining, welding, or post-weld machining sequence.
The file-format decision has no effect on the required 45-degree angle between the lug hole axes.
